age.evidence: Adult male Sprague-Dawley rats weighing 250-280 g at the start of the study were used.

sex.evidence: Adult male Sprague-Dawley rats weighing 250-280 g at the start of the study were used... Rats were randomly assigned to five experimental cohorts (n = 10 per group).

dosing.doses_raw: a single intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection of PSY at 2.5, 5, or 10 mg/kg
dosing.evidence: PSY was dissolved in sterile normal saline (0.9% w/v NaCl)... followed by a single intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection of PSY at 2.5, 5, or 10 mg/kg. This single dose was given on Day 15. (5 and 10 mg/kg groups died; only 2.5 mg/kg entered behavioural testing.)

group_housing.evidence: The animals were housed in pairs in standard polycarbonate cages... (Post-surgery: 'Animals were housed individually and provided a 13-day postoperative recovery'; however during the testing period 'companion rats were temporarily transferred to an identical adjacent holding cage' for LFP recordings, implying pair housing during testing.)

day_night_flipped.evidence: a 12-hour light/dark cycle (lights on at 07:00 AM)... All drug administrations, across every cohort, took place during the light phase of the diurnal cycle

enrichment_housing.evidence: Standard polycarbonate cages; no enrichment items mentioned.

assays.assay_description: Day 20; symmetric acrylic Y-maze (arms 40×15×30 cm, 120°); 8-min free exploration; spontaneous alternation percentage and total arm entries. Groups: Control, STZ, STZ+PSY 2.5 mg/kg (single i.p. dose Day 15).

application_type.evidence: a single intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection of PSY

setup_habituation.evidence: No pre-test apparatus habituation described for the Y-maze.

setup_restrain.evidence: Each rat was placed at the central junction and allowed to explore freely for 8 min

food_restriction.evidence: No food in the Y-maze apparatus during the test; chow ad libitum in home cage.

water_restriction.evidence: No water in the Y-maze apparatus during the test.

time_to_assay.evidence: single dose was given on Day 15... the Y-maze on Day 20

sample_size.evidence: Data are expressed as mean ± SEM (n = 10 rats per group) (Fig. 4)

outcomes.summary: ICV-STZ reduced spontaneous alternation below chance; a single 2.5 mg/kg psilocybin dose restored alternation to Control levels. Total arm entries did not differ among groups.
outcomes.statistics: SAP: F(2,27)=48.40, p<0.0001; STZ vs Control p<0.0001; STZ+PSY vs STZ p<0.0001; STZ+PSY vs Control p>0.05. Total arm entries: F(2,27)=0.85, p=0.44.
outcomes.evidence: PSY reversed much of that deficit: STZ + PSY animals alternated significantly more often than untreated STZ rats (p < 0.0001), and their performance no longer differed from Control (p > 0.05).

B1_num_measures.evidence: Spontaneous alternation percentage (SAP)... Total arm entries were also recorded on their own

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: An alternation was scored as correct when an animal entered all three arms consecutively within an overlapping triad.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Spatial working memory was assessed on Day 20

B7_automated_classification.evidence: tracked by a synchronized digital tracking system

E1_environment_type.evidence: symmetric Y-maze made of three identical acrylic arms (40 × 15 × 30 cm)

E6_spatial.evidence: Three arms branching from a central junction; open extensions, not enclosed compartments (analogous to EPM rule).

E7_social_context.evidence: Each rat was placed at the central junction

D1_continuity.evidence: Spatial working memory was assessed on Day 20

D2_session_duration.evidence: allowed to explore freely for 8 min

D5_followup.evidence: single dose was given on Day 15... Y-maze on Day 20 (5 days post-dose)

assays.assay_description: Days 25-26; open-field enclosure (48×48×42 cm) lined with bedding; 5-min familiarization with two identical objects, 80-min ITI, 3-min retention test with one novel object; discrimination index and novel/familiar exploration times.

application_type.evidence: a single intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection of PSY

setup_habituation.evidence: No pre-exposure to the arena described beyond the familiarization trial.

setup_restrain.evidence: the animal was returned to the arena for a 3-minute retention test

time_to_assay.evidence: single dose was given on Day 15... novel object recognition (NOR) across Days 25-26

sample_size.evidence: Data are expressed as mean ± SEM (n = 10 rats per group) (Fig. 5)

outcomes.summary: The discrimination index did not differ significantly among groups (STZ numerically lower, PSY numerically higher). Exploration times showed a Group×Object interaction: Control and STZ+PSY explored the novel object more than the familiar one, whereas STZ did not.
outcomes.statistics: DI: F(2,27)=2.00, p=0.155; Tukey Control vs STZ p=0.55, STZ vs STZ+PSY p=0.13; one-sample t vs 0.5: Control p=0.022, STZ+PSY p=0.0005, STZ p=0.63. Exploration: Object F(1,27)=12.12, p=0.0017; Group×Object F(2,27)=6.01, p=0.0069; Sidak Control p=0.025, STZ+PSY p=0.010, STZ p=0.94.
outcomes.evidence: one-way ANOVA using the corrected, ratio-based DI values did not show a significant overall effect of treatment (F(2,27)= 2.00, p = 0.155)

B1_num_measures.evidence: two complementary readouts: the DI and the raw time spent exploring each object

B6_cognitive.evidence: Recognition memory was assayed between Days 25-26

E3_bedding.evidence: openfield enclosure (48 × 48 × 42 cm) lined with standard bedding

D1_continuity.evidence: 5-minute familiarization trial... 3-minute retention test... Animals exhibiting total exploration durations below 10 s across trials were excluded

D3_recording_days.evidence: Following a strict 80-minute inter-trial interval (both trials same day per animal)

D5_followup.evidence: single dose on Day 15; NOR Days 25-26

assays.assay_name: Barnes maze spatial learning and memory task
assays.assay_description: Days 27-31; elevated circular platform (122 cm, 20 holes) with hidden escape box, 90-dB white noise + 500-W light; 4 acquisition days (trials ≤120 s) + Day-5 probe; escape latency, errors, GS/NGS entries and ratio, search-strategy classification.

application_type.evidence: a single intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection of PSY

setup_habituation.evidence: After a brief habituation period, animals underwent a series of acquisition trials

setup_restrain.evidence: Free movement on elevated platform; no restraint described.

time_to_assay.evidence: single dose was given on Day 15... Barnes maze test (BMT) from Days 27-31

sample_size.evidence: Data are presented as mean ± SEM (n = 10 rats per group) (Fig. 6)

outcomes.summary: ICV-STZ increased escape latency and errors; psilocybin 2.5 mg/kg normalized latency and reduced errors relative to STZ, increased probe-trial goal-sector entries, and shifted search strategy from random toward spatial on Days 3-4. GS/NGS ratio did not differ.
outcomes.evidence: by Day 5, STZ-treated rats exhibited significantly longer latencies (47.17 ± 1.81 s) than the Control (15.70 ± 2.70 s; p < 0.0001) and STZ + 2.5 PSY groups (17.43 ± 2.52 s; p < 0.0001)

B1_num_measures.evidence: we derived escape latency, total errors (incorrect nose pokes), the balance of goal-sector (GS) versus non-goal-sector (NGS) exploration, and the resulting GS/NGS ratio... classified each animal's search behavior... into one of three strategies

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Learning curves across days (between-session), not within-session.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: serial search (sequential exploration of adjacent holes...), and random search (non-localized exploration, frequent direction changes, or central maze crossings)

B6_cognitive.evidence: Spatial learning and reference memory retention were assessed

E1_environment_type.evidence: elevated circular platform (122 cm diameter) containing 20 evenly spaced peripheral holes

E2_shelter.evidence: Escape box is the task goal (trial endpoint), not a freely available refuge.

D1_continuity.evidence: Acquisition trials took place across Days 1-4; on the last day of testing (Day 5), we ran a probe trial

D2_session_duration.evidence: acquisition trials, each capped at 120 s

assays.assay_description: Day 22; plus maze 50 cm high, arms 30×5 cm, closed walls 15 cm; 5-min test; open/closed arm time and entries via automated video tracking.

application_type.evidence: a single intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection of PSY

setup_restrain.evidence: The rats were released facing an open arm and monitored for 5 min.

time_to_assay.evidence: single dose was given on Day 15... the elevated plus maze (EPM) on Day 22

outcomes.summary: No group differences on any EPM parameter; neither ICV-STZ nor psilocybin altered anxiety-like behaviour or closed-arm locomotion.
outcomes.statistics: Open arm entries (%) F(2,27)=0.2420, p=0.7867; open arm time (%) F=1.254, p=0.3016; open arm entries F=0.4607, p=0.6357; open arm time (s) F=1.356, p=0.2746; closed arm entries F=0.3156, p=0.7320; closed arm time F=0.7514, p=0.4813.
outcomes.evidence: One-way ANOVA found no significant group differences on any EPM parameter (p > 0.05).

B1_num_measures.evidence: Table 2: open arm entries (%), open arm time (%), open arm entries (No.), open arm time (s), closed arm entries (No.), closed arm time (s)

B6_cognitive.evidence: a standard conflict-based test of anxiety-like behavior

B7_automated_classification.evidence: extracted using automated videotracking modules (position tracking)

E1_environment_type.evidence: elevated plus-maze apparatus situated 50 cm above the room floor

E2_shelter.evidence: EPM closed arms are not a shelter per rubric.

E6_spatial.evidence: EPM arms are open-ended extensions of a central platform (rubric).

D5_followup.evidence: Dose Day 15; EPM Day 22 (7 days post).

assays.assay_description: Day 33; glass cylinder (30×50×60 cm), water 25±1 °C, 25 cm depth; 15-min pretest Day 32; 6-min test measuring latency to first immobility (first 2 min) and total immobility (final 4 min).

application_type.evidence: a single intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection of PSY

setup_habituation.evidence: all animals underwent a 15-minute pretest habituation trial 24 h earlier (Day 32)

setup_restrain.evidence: FST cylinder: transparent glass cylinder... filled with water

water_restriction.evidence: Swim water is not a drinking source; no water bottle.

time_to_assay.evidence: single dose was given on Day 15... forced swim test (FST) on Day 33

sample_size.evidence: Data are presented as mean ± SEM (n = 10 rats per group) (Fig. 7)

outcomes.summary: STZ lengthened latency to first immobility vs Control; psilocybin shortened it back toward Control. Psilocybin significantly reduced total immobility relative to STZ (STZ vs Control difference not significant, p=0.068).
outcomes.statistics: Latency: F(2,27)=13.63, p<0.0001; STZ vs Control p<0.0001; STZ+PSY vs STZ p<0.01; STZ+PSY vs Control p=0.43. Total immobility: F(2,27)=11.22, p=0.0003; STZ vs Control p=0.068; STZ+PSY vs STZ p<0.001; STZ+PSY vs Control p=0.059.
outcomes.evidence: PSY treatment significantly reduced total immobility time in the STZ + 2.5 PSY group (91.80 ± 4.85 s) relative to the STZ-alone group (p < 0.001)

B1_num_measures.evidence: The initial 2 min were used to measure the latency to the first immobility event, while the final 4 min were used to calculate the total immobility duration.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Fixed epoch split for two separate measures, not a within-session time-course analysis.

E1_environment_type.evidence: transparent glass cylinder (30 × 50 × 60 cm) filled with water

D1_continuity.evidence: The assessment session lasted for 6 min (pretest data not reported).

D2_session_duration.evidence: The assessment session lasted for 6 min.

D3_recording_days.evidence: Behavioral despair was measured on day 33

D4_baseline.evidence: Day 32 pretest occurred after drug dosing (Day 15), not a pre-drug baseline.

D5_followup.evidence: Dose Day 15; FST Day 33 (18 days post).

judge_notes: Five behavioural assays retained (Y-maze, NOR, Barnes maze, EPM, FST); all candidates agreed. LFP recordings and rectal-temperature/survival monitoring excluded as non-behavioural.
Dosing lists 2.5, 5 and 10 mg/kg (all administered); only 2.5 mg/kg survived into behavioural testing.

group_housing set to 'yes' (medium): paper states pair housing and individual housing during post-op recovery, but LFP methods describe companion rats being moved out of the home cage during Days 14-34 recordings, implying pair housing during testing.
Corrected gemma's B1 scores (score must match category: 2-3 measures = 1) and its erroneous time_to_assay minutes and D5=No (all tests ≥5 days post-dose → D5=1).

Barnes B1 set to 7+ (latency, errors, GS, NGS, GS/NGS ratio, three strategy percentages); B2=0 (across-day, not within-session; modal); B3=1 (strategy classification of sequential search; modal); E2=0 for escape box (task goal, modal).
Y-maze B3=1 (modal; alternation scored from consecutive arm-entry triads); E6=0 (modal; arms treated as open extensions like EPM).
NOR: D1=1 (modal; familiarization exploration quantified for exclusion), D3 overridden to 1 day because the 80-min ITI places both trials on the same day for each animal; B4=0 (modal).
FST: Day-32 pretest data not reported, so D1/D2/D3 based on the 6-min test (modal); B2=0 (modal); water_restriction 'during' (modal).
